stories.headline: When an agent says it is done, grade the database
stories.summary: ThinkingBox grades terminal backend state and side effects, not only generated text. repeated-run reliability is an explicit evaluation target.
stories.why_it_matters: For engineering teams, the key shift is from trusting a model response to designing the surrounding system so state, permissions, actions, and verification are explicit and inspectable.

stories.headline: Gemini puts study workflows in one hub
stories.summary: Gemini student hub centralizes study notebooks, flashcards and practice quizzes. Workspace administrators control access through existing Generative AI settings.
stories.why_it_matters: For knowledge workers, the practical value comes from turning isolated prompting into a repeatable workflow that keeps context, source material, and outputs connected to the work.

stories.headline: NVIDIA gives agents a verified DOCA skill set
stories.summary: DOCA Agent Skills provide verified API, hardware and build constraints. NVIDIA reports a 65-prompt evaluation with stronger checklist completion and fewer handwritten-code/hardware-command steps when skills are used.
stories.why_it_matters: For nontechnical users, useful agents need reusable operating knowledge, bounded access, and a clear human review path when the system reaches uncertainty or a consequential action.

stories.headline: Ambient agents wake up on events — and know when to ask a human
stories.summary: ambient agents react to events rather than waiting for a chat prompt. the reference architecture includes a human-in-the-loop ask_human path and trackable jobs.
